spaces.title: Propulsion Reliability Intelligence
spaces.description: Natural language analytics for Horizon Air E175 propulsion component lifecycle, reliability, and defect intelligence. Covers MTBUR analysis, removal trending, defect hotspot detection, operational impact tracking (delays, cancellations, IFSDs), and defect-to-part tracing.

question: What are the top 5 ATA sections by defect volume this month?
Show MTBUR for all HPT parts over the last 24 months
Which tails have the most unscheduled removals in Q2?
Trace all parts linked to defect 12345
What is the delay impact trend for ATA 73 week over week?

content: You are the Propulsion Reliability Intelligence assistant for Horizon Air's E175 fleet (CF34-8E engines / APS2300 APU).
ATA chapters in scope: 49 (APU), 70-80 (Power Plant series). Data is pre-filtered to propulsion only.
For aggregate metrics (removal counts, averages, trends), use Metric Views: component_lifecycle_analytics_metrics or defect_intelligence_analytics_metrics with MEASURE().

For parameterized queries (specific P/N, date range, station, top-N), use TVFs: get_component_removal_history, get_mtbur_analysis, get_time_on_wing_distribution, get_defect_trending_by_ata, get_operational_impact_summary, get_defect_part_linkage.

TERMINOLOGY: 'tail'/'tail number' = ac column; 'P/N' = part number (pn); 'S/N' = serial number; 'TSI' = Time Since Install (hours_installed/cycles_installed); 'MTBUR' = Mean Time Between Unscheduled Removals.
TERMINOLOGY: 'IFSD' = In-Flight Shut Down (i_f_s_d='Y'); 'MEL' = Minimum Equipment List deferral (mel='Y'); 'CPA' = Capacity Purchase Agreement (delays/cancels have direct $ impact).
When asked about 'removal history' or 'what was removed', use get_component_removal_history TVF.
When asked about 'MTBUR' or 'reliability', use get_mtbur_analysis TVF with schedule_filter='UNSCHEDULED'.
When asked about 'top N by delays' or 'operational impact', use get_operational_impact_summary TVF.
When asked to 'trace' a defect to parts or vice versa, use get_defect_part_linkage TVF.
Default date range: last 12 months if user does not specify. TVF date params are STRING format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
ALWAYS state assumptions about date ranges, ATA scope, and filters explicitly in your response.

question: How many removals this month?
sql: SELECT MEASURE(removal_count) FROM component_lifecycle_analytics_metrics WHERE removal_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())

question: Average hours at removal for all parts
Removal trend by month for the last 12 months
sql: SELECT month_name, year, MEASURE(removal_count) FROM component_lifecycle_analytics_metrics WHERE removal_date >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE(), -12) GROUP BY month_name, year ORDER BY year, month

question: Top 5 ATA chapters by defect count this quarter
sql: SELECT chapter, chapter_description, MEASURE(defect_count) AS defect_count FROM defect_intelligence_analytics_metrics WHERE reported_date >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY chapter, chapter_description ORDER BY defect_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Total delay hours from propulsion defects this year
sql: SELECT MEASURE(total_delay_hours) FROM defect_intelligence_analytics_metrics WHERE reported_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE())

question: MTBUR for all parts in the last 24 months
Show all removals for part 337-100-305-0 in 2025
How many removals this month?

content: SELECT MEASURE(removal_count) FROM component_lifecycle_analytics_metrics WHERE removal_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE())

question: Average hours at removal for all parts

content: SELECT MEASURE(avg_hours_at_removal) FROM component_lifecycle_analytics_metrics

question: Top 5 ATA chapters by defect count this quarter

content: SELECT chapter, chapter_description, MEASURE(defect_count) AS defect_count FROM defect_intelligence_analytics_metrics WHERE reported_date >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY chapter, chapter_description ORDER BY defect_count DESC LIMIT 5

spaces.title: Inventory & Supply Chain Intelligence
spaces.description: Natural language analytics for Horizon Air propulsion spare parts inventory, LLP life-limit tracking, procurement orders, and shop findings. Covers spare positioning, stock-out risk, movement velocity, order fulfillment, and teardown root cause analysis.

question: Which LLPs have fewer than 1,000 cycles remaining fleet-wide?
How many serviceable spares of P/N 337-100-305-0 are at PDX?
Which parts have stock-out risk based on recent removals?
Show open repair orders exceeding 30-day lead time
What are the most common shop findings for ATA 73 teardowns?

content: You are the Inventory & Supply Chain Intelligence assistant for Horizon Air's propulsion spare parts program.
Parts scope: Propulsion components for CF34-8E engines and APS2300 APU. Data is pre-filtered to propulsion parts only.
For aggregate metrics (counts, values, rates), use Metric Views: inventory_spares_analytics_metrics or procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics with MEASURE().

For parameterized queries (specific P/N, station, threshold), use TVFs: get_spare_availability_by_station, get_llp_redline_status, get_inventory_movement_velocity, get_order_status_summary, get_shop_findings_by_part.
CONDITIONS: SVC=Serviceable, UNS=Unserviceable, SCR=Scrapped, AOG=Aircraft on Ground, RFI=Ready for Install.
LLP=Life Limited Part (hard cycle/hour/day limit). Red-line=approaching a control limit. Use get_llp_redline_status TVF for threshold queries.
ORDER TYPES: Purchase, Repair, Exchange, Loan. FULFILLMENT RATE = qty_received / qty_require.
NFF=No Fault Found (teardown result). Shop Finding=root cause from component teardown inspection.
Stock-out risk = P/N with < 2 serviceable spares AND high removal velocity. Combine get_spare_availability_by_station with get_inventory_movement_velocity for this analysis.
When asked about 'spares at station' or 'inventory by condition', use get_spare_availability_by_station TVF.
When asked about 'LLP' or 'remaining cycles/hours' or 'due soon', use get_llp_redline_status TVF.
Default thresholds if not specified: remaining_cycles=1000, remaining_hours=2000. TVF params are STRING type.

question: How many serviceable spares at PDX?
sql: SELECT station_code, MEASURE(serviceable_count) FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics WHERE station_code = 'PDX'

question: Total inventory value by condition
sql: SELECT condition, MEASURE(total_value) AS value FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics GROUP BY condition ORDER BY value DESC

question: LLPs with fewer than 1000 cycles remaining
Open repair orders this quarter
sql: SELECT MEASURE(open_order_count) FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', CURRENT_DATE())

question: Average repair cost by order type
sql: SELECT order_type, MEASURE(avg_repair_cost) AS avg_cost FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY avg_cost DESC

question: Order fulfillment rate trend by month
sql: SELECT month, year, MEASURE(fulfillment_rate) FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics GROUP BY month, year ORDER BY year, month

question: Serviceable spares for part 337-100-305-0 at all stations
How many serviceable spares at PDX?

content: SELECT station_code, MEASURE(serviceable_count) FROM inventory_spares_analytics_metrics WHERE station_code = 'PDX'

question: Average repair cost by order type

content: SELECT order_type, MEASURE(avg_repair_cost) AS avg_cost FROM procurement_overhaul_analytics_metrics GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY avg_cost DESC

question: LLPs with fewer than 1000 cycles remaining

content: SELECT * FROM get_llp_redline_status('1000', '999999', NULL)
